title: Family, Home, And Location Open Answer
concept: Family, Home, And Location Japanese composition

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: I get up at seven.
questions.explanation: Time + に: Mark a specific time when an action occurs.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: I work from nine to five.
acceptedAnswers: 九時から五時まで働きます。
questions.explanation: Noun + から・まで: Mark the starting and ending point of time or place.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: I buy bread and eggs.
questions.explanation: Noun + と + Noun: Join nouns in a complete list meaning and.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: There are books, pens, and such on the desk.
acceptedAnswers: 机の上に本やペンがあります。
questions.explanation: Noun + や + Noun: Give representative examples from a larger list.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: I study Japanese every day.
acceptedAnswers: 毎日日本語を勉強します。
questions.explanation: Verb stem + ます: Express a habitual or future action politely.

questions.prompt: Write the Japanese sentence: I will not work today.
questions.explanation: Verb stem + ません: Express that a present or future action does not happen.
